revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing an indoor parking garage. Scene includes concrete pillars, parked vehicles, lane markings with industrial vinyl, and partial shadow from nearby structure, with clear subject detail. Left-oblique view at closer inspection distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Visible subject is a young adult woman with an athletic build wearing a pale sweater and black trousers, with blue and charcoal clothing tones, performing a controlled plank beside a marked work area, with hands and feet actively supporting her body and no passive ground rest. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, clean floor markings that do not form symbols or labels. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising style. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
